I've replied to Hollis in his DM. I couldn't give him a named escalation contact or phone number for Marrow Agrisupply, because none of the channels or files he can see list one. That includes #central-team, #central-random, the Tansley incident room and the public Central notes and digests. He also can't see any Marrow account profile or CRM file.

Instead, I pointed him to how the last Marrow escalation was handled, on 9 June in #central-team:
- **Customer side or store operations:** start with Pree (Priyanka Sundaram). Last time she called Marrow's store ops and the receiving leads at each store.
- **Product or setup problems:** go through support, and mention ticket PD-4821 if it's related. Hollis took setup and support on that escalation himself.

I offered to draft a note to Pree or post a heads-up in #central-team once he tells me what's broken. I only used what Hollis can see himself, and I didn't send any email or call `search_messages`.
